top_reviews.title: Wow! They work for flat (no arch) feet without gapping open!!!
top_reviews.text:
I’m in love! I’ve finally found a pair of flats on Amazon that are worthy of all “flat-footers”. They do not gap open on the sides, they have just the right amount of cushion without being too soft, which is bad for those without an arch. We usually have to wear a shoe that has more “stability”/support and will not give or make your heel sink. The sole is a hard/firm rubber, not the soft squishy type, which is another plus for those with no arch.

The small wedge is just the right height and ratio for comfort without sliding nor heal twisting…the fabric “hugs” the heals without being tight. I wore these around my house and didn’t feel any discomfort within any part of the flats.

The rhinestones and beads are attached well, and look high-end…nothing was loose nor hanging. These versatile flats can definitely work for everyday casual, work or an elegant affair.

I am impressed and pleased. I recommend these comfortable and amazingly priced ballet flats! Now I need the gold ones!

top_reviews.title: Wow! They work for flat (no arch) feet without gapping open!!!
top_reviews.text:
I’m in love! I’ve finally found a pair of flats on Amazon that are worthy of all “flat-footers”. They do not gap open on the sides, they have just the right amount of cushion without being too soft, which is bad for those without an arch. We usually have to wear a shoe that has more “stability”/support and will not give or make your heel sink. The sole is a hard/firm rubber, not the soft squishy type, which is another plus for those with no arch.

The small wedge is just the right height and ratio for comfort without sliding nor heal twisting…the fabric “hugs” the heals without being tight. I wore these around my house and didn’t feel any discomfort within any part of the flats.

The rhinestones and beads are attached well, and look high-end…nothing was loose nor hanging. These versatile flats can definitely work for everyday casual, work or an elegant affair.

I am impressed and pleased. I recommend these comfortable and amazingly priced ballet flats! Now I need the gold ones!

top_reviews.title: Half Sizes - Not Really (FYI-Size Issue)
top_reviews.text:
The shoes are definitely cute and 5 star quality. I gave them 4 stars because I had to order them twice.
I ordered an 8.5, on first order, which is my normal size. They were too large. The size on the packaging was 40; which I correlate with Size 10.

I ordered an 8 on the second order. These fit perfectly. The size on the packaging was 39; which I correlate to a Size 9.

top_reviews.title: Useful shoes, but pretty too
top_reviews.text: These shoes come all folded up. It would be very easy to put these in a little bag for a night out in case the fancy heels get too uncomfortable. We’ve all been there. These would also be great to leave at work, since they’ll go with almost any outfit, so if you have a shoe that breaks or becomes overly uncomfortable, these would be perfect back ups. But these also look like great shoes just to wear. The flowers, rhinestones, and glitter make them look fancy enough that you could wear them to a formal occasion. However, they’re not too over the top to wear to spice up a casual outfit. They look great with jeans or leggings. These have a very pointed toe, more so than it appears in the picture. Usually I avoid pointed toes because my toes are square, and I find them very uncomfortable. These however are big and stretchy enough that I can wear them a whole day without getting that tight pinched feeling. These are pretty shoes. They don’t have a lot of padding or support, but most ballet flats don’t. They do have decent width and are still very comfortable.
